subject.title: feat: add portable table presentation blocks

question: Should portable tables become a supported public plugin SDK presentation contract with the bundled cross-channel fallback behavior proposed by this PR?
rationale: The code is technically coherent, but adding a permanent plugin-facing semantic block and committing every bundled channel to its fallback semantics is a product and API ownership decision that automation cannot make.

options.title: Accept the additive table contract
options.body: Approve the shared table primitive and channel-owned projections, contingent on a current-main rebase and real Slack native/fallback proof.

options.title: Limit the first release to Slack
options.body: Keep the table contract internal or narrower until maintainers separately approve the public plugin SDK and sibling-channel fallback commitments.

options.title: Pause the table primitive
options.body: Leave the canonical issue open if maintainers prefer Markdown or provider-native payloads rather than another portable presentation block.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive table contract
recommendation.body: Approve the shared table primitive and channel-owned projections, contingent on a current-main rebase and real Slack native/fallback proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged chart work established the adjacent public presentation architecture and they documented tables as the next unresolved slice.
